result.title: Solvable dynamics model of in-context learning
result.summary: Pretrained Transformer architectures display a surprising in-context learning ability without additional training. How the learning process guides the network to achieve this intriguing capability remains unsolved. In this study, we focus on a single-layer, single-head linear attention model, where empirical risk minimization is defined for learning. Given a finite amount of training examples, we determine the exact solution of network parameter dynamics, which is linked to the training error and generalization error, characterizing how memorization and generalization emerge from learning and how these transitions are related to curvatures of the empirical risk landscape. Furthermore, we calculate a data-dependent free energy, from which the training and generalization errors in the long-time limit of learning dynamics can be well predicted. Our work adds insights toward understanding the mechanism of in-context learning, especially from a learning dynamics perspective.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究单层单头线性注意力模型的上下文学习，在有限训练样本下求出参数动力学的精确解，将记忆与泛化的出现及转变联系到经验风险曲率，并用数据依赖的自由能预测长期训练和泛化误差。
